The scale classes, for subclassing and dispatch

Source: R/scale-class.R
scale_class.Rd

These return the classes NestedScale and ScaleProduct, which are also exported under their own names. Needed to build a subclass (S7::new_class(..., parent = scale_class()), which is what scale_alias_property() is for) or to register an S7 method against one. To merely ask what an object is, use scale_is().

Usage

scale_class()

scale_product_class()

Value

The S7 class object.

Examples

scale_class()
#> <nestedscales::NestedScale> class
#> @ parent     : <S7_object>
#> @ constructor: function(leaftable, frames, members, leaf, meta, attributes, aliases, labels) {...}
#> @ validator  : function(self) {...}
#> @ properties :
#>  $ leaftable: S3<data.frame>
#>  $ frames: <character> = character(0)
#>  $ members: <list> = list()
#>  $ leaf: <character> = "leaf"
#>  $ meta: <list> = list()
#>  $ attributes: <ANY> = .empty_attributes()
#>  $ aliases: <ANY> = .empty_aliases()
#>  $ labels: <ANY> = .empty_labels()
S7::S7_inherits(scale_example(), scale_class())
#> [1] TRUE
